project.title: Protocol City
project.charter_excerpt: Protocol City is a local coordination desk for operators. It records intent, boundaries, decisions and live desk state.

charter.title: Charter

sections.heading: Charter for Local Desk
sections.body: Operator console for a private BluePrint cell.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: Provide local observation and control for Agents, Jobs, and Pulse.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This desk may view and interact with local cell state only. No remote cells. No external orchestration.

sections.heading: Invariants
sections.body:
• Never act on unverified state
• Never expose private keys
• Never assume network trust

charter.footer: Cellar app tip v0.1.50_6 — not private Protocol City install
